name: AENIGMA
source:
AENIGMA is a sci-fi visual novel that follows the war on silicon-based lifeforms. Set in the year 4XXX, humanity lives disconnected inside underground megastructures to escape the threat of the ever-expanding silicon life.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4210100/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
AENIGMA是一部科幻视觉小说，讲述了硅基生命体的战争。故事发生在4XXX年，人类生活在地下巨型建筑内，以躲避不断扩张的硅生命的威胁。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4210100/]Steam[/url]]
